The War Eternal Supply Drop
Use this to sign your account up for weekly War Eternal Supply Drops. Receive the first immediately and three more between now and May 21.

First Drop:
Exotic Breeds Mount Select License, a choice of one Desert Racer, Distant Lands, or Istani Isles mount select license or an Exotic Breeds Mount Adoption License, the Elonian Adversaries Dye Pack, and one Mini Green Raptor Hatchling, Mini Yellow Jackal Pup, Mini Red Griffon Hatchling, Mini Brown Springer Kit, and Mini Blue Skimmer Pup.
Second Drop:
Black Lion Outfit Voucher, Onyx and Gold Lion Weapon Choice, and 2 Black Lion Miniature Claim Tickets.
Third Drop:
Black Lion Backpack and Glider Voucher, Communal Boost Bonfire, 2 Heroic Boosters, 5 Black Lion Statuettes.
Fourth Drop:
Branded Weapon Select Box, 2 Guaranteed Wardrobe Unlocks, 5 Black Lion Chest Keys.

Commander %str1%,

Thanks to coordination with Delaqua Investigations, the paperwork involving...well, everything that happened on your big trip here has mostly been handled. Mostly. But we've still got grumblings from various ministry departments whose feathers were ruffled, and it would be a big help if you could drop by. Nothing to sign; just a few appearances so that MinSec can remind certain parties what an important VIP the commander is.

It's not my business, but Min would really appreciate it. Which means it is my business a bit, and I'd take it as a big favor. Let's meet up in Arborstone.

—Rama

Greetings, Traveler,It is our understanding that you've become a recognizable and welcome face throughout the Metrica Province. You've been making quite a name for yourself. Your accomplishments include everything from golem research to chaos magic. Equal parts adventure and meta-scientific breakthrough. Everything a journey through the Metrica Province should be.We wish you luck in your future explorations. — Tyrian Explorers Society

Enclosed is your yield from our ongoing assignments. Another shipment will be sent tomorrow. Remember, you can always change the locations your teams are gathering from at the Black Lion Requisition Teams Post in your home instance.

—Black Lion Requisitions Division
Congratulations, <Character name>. When I first saw you, I never imagined we'd end up here. We should toast to Tybalt...or maybe we should get a few pirates in here so you can out-drink them, eh?

Greetings, friend,Spring is just around the corner, and the Eldvin Monastery has begun preparations for another brewing season. This month's Pale Tree Pilsner was inspired by the Pale Tree herself. This brew is a light, crystal-clear brew, perfect for springtime. The hops provide a perfect balance with the other robust flavors found in this brew. Good health and a glass for your thirst,—Desch Metz,Master Brewer, Eldvin Monastery

My dear %str1%,The Pale Tree has agreed to an audience, but she wishes to speak with you personally. I'm already in the Grove with Braham and Rox. We'll wait for you here. Please come at your earliest convenience. Sincerely,—Kasmeer

Thank you for everything you've done at Owl's Abbatoir. Through your selfless acts, you have truly honored Owl. It gives me hope that her teachings will yet be remembered and inspires me to do more myself.

Sincerely,

—Lahri
Welcome to Guild Wars 2! To help you on your adventures in Tyria, your character has been given a seven-day bonus booster. Enjoy!

Greetings, Wayfinder,

You departed during the battle against Nourys with participation remaining, so please find enclosed some of the rewards you missed. Thank you for your aid in the fight for Amnytas.

Greetings,It's unfortunate I am not contacting you with good news. We have received several reports of Mordrem moving outward from the Heart of Maguuma and appearing in areas around Tyria. It is imperative that we do everything possible to prevent Mordremoth from creating footholds close to our major cities.I have included information on areas to investigate. Please be wary. We have detected a lot of underground activity in Brisban Wildlands, Kessex Hills, and Diessa Plateau. Gather your friends and do all you can to beat the elder dragon's minions back.Best of luck,—Mordrem Researcher Eullo of the Durmand Priory

Commander,Are you aware of our new paratrooper division? Our parachutes are military grade and offer increased mobility throughout Drizzlewood Coast. If we're going to win this war, need every advantage we can get.Come speak to me in Umbral Grotto.Over and out.
"Welcome to Camp Resolve, Commander."
Commander, glad you got my letter. Here's the situation: Organs are making theretheir way outta Bava Nisos. And they sure didn't just get up and walk away on their own...

Greetings, friend, 

Your helping hand with the poor refugees was a touch of comfort. The beacons you lit to guide them represent your own shining strength, and the food you gathered shows you to be a pillar of support. We are indebted to you.

—Enduring Protector

Commander %str1%,

The sun shines again today on Elona, on what I hope will be remembered as the beginning of an age of peace. We have you to thank for that—your battles against the god of war are still spoken of in the villages and halls.

I write to you to ask you to work together with me again. The Sunspears are rebuilding, and we have more new recruits than I could have imagined. Seeing your courage and conviction would lend them strength. 

Help me show the people that we can stand as Elona's protectors once again.

—Zaeim, Spearmarshal of the Sunspears
Congratulations to all participants!
"Welcome to Augury's Shadow, home to the Followers of Ascension. Xunn is searching for Forgotten glyphs, Dawnwynn cuts down Branded, and Adisa collects Slivers of Vlast for my smithing."
"Welcome to the garrison. Hope you find your stay pleasant, and if you're just passing through, feel free to take out some centaurs before you go."
Commander, please, are you there...?
"Commander, you seem to have forgotten this."

Dear %str1%,
I've finally achieved my lifelong dream of becoming a king. I'm still down here in the well, but surely my subjects above wouldn't forget about me, would they? I'll need some help when I make my grand emergence—it's been so long since I've seen light that I don't think my eyes, you know, function anymore. Make the appropriate arrangements for your lord, won't you? 

—His Majesty King Blaine, Regent of Winslow Well

By the Province of Empress Ihn

Commander,

As our relations with Kryta and Queen Jennah blossom, the queen has invited Canthan delegates to come teach Canthan culture in her city. Likewise, she'll be sending some of her own to our shores to do the same.

I'm especially eager for you to meet with Sang-Mi. As an adept necromancer yourself, I think you could learn from her teachings.

Respectfully,
Empress Ihn of Cantha
Commander, be careful. Creatures from the Mists are known for their trickery. It may be trying to butter you up and manipulate you.

"The 8th Anniversary Supply Drop
Use this to sign your account up for weekly 8th Anniversary Supply Drops. Receive the first drop immediately and three more between now and September 15.

First Drop:
5 Black Lion Chest Keys, a Golden Black Lion Chest Key, 2 Guaranteed Wardrobe Unlocks, and a Lorekeeper Weapon Select Box.
Second Drop:
A Bizarre Beasts Mount Select License, a choice of one Exotic Breeds, Mistborn, Curious Creatures, or New Horizons Mount Select License or a Bizarre Beasts Mount Adoption License, and a Black Lion Outfit Voucher.
Third Drop:
A Black Lion Dye Canister Package, a Black Lion Backpack and Glider Voucher, and a Black Lion Weapons Voucher.
Fourth Drop:
5 Black Lion Statuettes, a Mythic Weapon Choice, 2 Black Lion Miniature Claim Tickets, and a Black Lion Booster Box."
Welcome to Augury's Shadow, home to the Followers of Ascension. Xunn is searching for Forgotten glyphs, Dawnwynn cuts down Branded, and Adisa collects Slivers of Vlast for my smithing.

Commander,Very exciting news! A crystalline resonance cascade scenario has occurred! You can read my upcoming publication...wait. That book already exists; it's right here on my desk.This already happened!Okay, so, remember when all of your green prophet shards and crystals turned blue? Maybe you don't; I somehow forgot. That was the primary crystalline resonance cascade scenario—it happened a while ago! BUT! NOW! This is so amazing: it REBOUNDS! I thought the original scenario passed and was done. All my theories are wrong! This book is blissfully foul and wrong! I don't deserve this truly massive shelf full of awards and accolades! I have to go throw it all out and consult my crystals! Red prophet shards don't even exist! Why would I write about them?I'm back. This is fine. Everything is fine. I don't care what Phlunt says—crystallography has not been turned on its sixth axis at all. We're OK. This is just going to keep happening periodically and that's fine.Your green prophet shards have turned blue. Again. My associate Zazzl now collects blue shards because all the shards in Cantha are blue now. This is just the world we live in.I'm assigning another protege—very smart kid—Nikki, to go find where the locus of green shards is centering. She'll take them off your hands until the next rebound event.
Wayfinder, I've a favor to ask. Vass cared for all things natural, both flora and fauna. We can't favor one over the other. To that end, I've undertaken my masterwork.

Greetings, friend,

Surviving the Foefire and aged for hundreds of years, this amazing discovery not only maintained drinkability, but it delivers a powerful flavor. Barrel-Aged Ascalonian Amber has a rich flavor that dominates the pallet. The deceptive copper color belies its strong flavors of fruits, oak, and a mild bitterness. This rare, ancient beer is highly sought after by collectors.

Good health and a glass for your thirst,

—Desch Metz,
Master Brewer, Eldvin Monastery
"Greetings, organic creature. Just kidding, it's me in here."
Greetings, citizen.

Greetings,

Because of efforts like yours, we know how big of a threat the bandits are to Kryta. We'll have to redouble their efforts against this menace. The citizens of Shaemoor deserve to live without fear of being kidnapped. With Balthazar's favor, we'll break those brigands for good. 

—Soldier Felix

Dear %str1%,

The krait in Slaver's Deeps have their tails between their legs. They won't be hassling us with as much vigor again any time soon. I just thought you should know.

—Lionguard Hester

Greetings, traveler,The Tyrian Explorers Society has been made aware of your accomplishments upon the Cursed Shore. We're impressed! Not many can boast of having explored the far reaches of Orr. Congratulations on having survived this challenging territory.We wish you luck in your future explorations. — Tyrian Explorers Society

The ore we got out of those dredge mines has been a lifesaver. Hopefully, they'll think twice before they attack us again. Best regards. 

—Surveyor Falki
Welcome, traveler. We can provide you with ale or anything else you need.
"Champion, help me! There's too much— This power, it's so wild. Get to the prisms!"
"Welcome, Commander. Hozza, forward Priory explorer, expert provisioner of goods, and savvy conversationalist, at your service."

Greetings, Commander,

On behalf of the Flame and Iron legions, we'd like to invite you to the Black Citadel for a pioneering one-on-one training session with one of Iron Legion's best and brightest guardians. As a decorated guardian yourself, Imperator Greetsglory and I agreed that you would be an exemplary outside candidate. Connect with Petrus Dawnwelder on the mustering grounds near the Vigil chapterhouse, and he'll instruct you from there.

Safe travels,
Mia Kindleshot, Iron Imperator

Welcome to Diessa Plateau. Traveling east of the haven, you'll find a few of our soldiers are on holiday celebrating Meatoberfest. It's a grand festival where you can eat and drink as much as you want. The only downside to the festival is that it makes us regular targets for Separatists. The noise also causes us grief with the dredge. They have a large base of operations north of the festival. And if they're not bothering us here, they're off bothering the miners at the quarry. We'd appreciate any assistance you could offer us. And don't forget to have a good time!

Greetings to you,

I wanted to let you know how grateful the Durmand Priory and I are for your assistance at Ghostsummit. Before you arrived and lent a welcome hand, we were having little success with fighting off the harpies, who were impeding our ability to continue our research along the wall. 

As you may know, the Durmand Priory has been gathering ancient Ascalonian artifacts with the hopes that they might reveal something about the nature of the ghosts we are forced to perpetually battle. Because of your assistance in this effort, we are now a little closer to that goal.

—Sagum Relicseeker
"Congratulations, candidate. You have taken another step closer to completing the rite of Divitium Nava."

Commander,To no one's surprise, Mabon and the wizards have employed their typical cryptic form of guidance. I'm sure you're left with more questions than answers about how to proceed. To that end, I'm sending you this report on known White Mantle activity over the past several months. Hopefully this will help you track down these touchstones.You can thank me later.—Livia

Commander,

First: sincerest congratulations on bringing down Kralkatorrik. Three Elder Dragons and a god—very impressive. That merits contemplation.

Which brings me to my second point: Tyria is changing. I find myself wondering about the shape of this new world and what the future holds for the Charr. So I've invited my fellow imperators, along with their best and brightest, to our Homelands for a grand convocation. A celebration of who the Charr are—and who we might become. I've even brokered a ceasefire with remnants of Flame, believe it or not.

I've also extended an invitation to some of our allies, and it should come as no surprise that you and your guild are at the top of that list. It would be my privilege to host a "champion" of your renown. After all, who else can say they have an Elder Dragon at their command?

I look forward to meeting you in the flesh. You'll find a chopper waiting at the Black Citadel.

Yours sincerely,

Bangar Ruinbringer
Imperator
Blood Legion

Enclosed is your yield from our ongoing expedition. Another shipment will be sent tomorrow. Remember, you can always change the location your team is gathering from at the Black Lion Expedition Board.

—Black Lion Expeditions Team

Commander,
I've read the early dispatches from your mission, and the krait orb is definitely something I want to examine. I'm preparing a team to study and deploy the object—get it and yourself back to Fort Trinity as soon as you can: Zhaitan's forces are planning a major assault on our headquarters, and I want the Pact to be ready. Until then,
—Marshal Trahearne
Congratulations on silencing a high-ranking White Mantle zealot. Not many can say they've done that.

Commander,

To no one's surprise, Mabon and the wizards have employed their typical cryptic form of guidance. I'm sure you're left with more questions than answers about how to proceed. To that end, I'm sending you this report on known White Mantle activity over the past several months. Hopefully this will help you track down these touchstones.

You can thank me later.
—Livia
"Greetings, I am the assistant to Lord Beetlestone's head chef. And you are?"

Commander,

I am Captain Thaddeus Soren of the Ebon Vanguard. I pray this message finds you with all due haste.

Our scouts are reporting increased destroyer activity all around Ebonhawke. I fear it's only a matter of time before the dragon of fire and destruction sets its sights on us.

I know you have been spearheading Tyria's efforts to counter the ongoing Elder Dragon attacks. We fear Ebonhawke is next.

—Captain Soren
"Welcome to the Guild Initiative Headquarters! Come in, we'll get you registered."

Commander,

Your allies are struggling to reach you from Castora—the magical anomalies surrounding the island continue to scatter all communication frequencies. A nautical expedition outside of Cantha was able to parse a message for you from Tribune Rytlock, however. Your party has detained a handful of Inquest scouts, but they are holding on questioning the detainees until your arrival.

Make haste.
Welcome to my world.
Commander, we need to make sure our allies are getting the support they need! They can't go this alone!
Welcome to our fine settlement. If you like grumpy old zealots, plenty of centaurs, and a good fight or two, you've come to the right place.

Wayfinder, hello.

I am sorry to ask more of you, but if you've some time one of my reports from the Bastion of the Natural has passed along troubling news of missing Astral Ward. She could use your knowledge of the battlefield to locate them. If there's any chance of returning them to safety alive, we should move quickly.

Her name is Hortensia, and she is likely working out of the refugee clinic in the Wizard's Tower.

Congratulations on defeating King Adelbern and foiling his plot to send his ghost army to Tyria's surface. Unfortunately, it appears that there were more than angry spirits lurking in the catacombs. 

It turns out that Adelbern and his ghostly minions were keeping darker things at bay in those ruined tombs. With Adelbern defeated, monsters are now rising to the surface and endangering a Durmand Priory camp located inside the catacombs.

I thought that you of all people would be interested in returning to the site of your previous triumph and setting matters right!

As always,

Your Herald

Dear Commander,

One of our secondborn, Cillian, has recently returned from their travels across Tyria and is quite eager to meet with you. Nothing too serious, mind, but they wished to consult with a storied and celebrated mesmer, and they could imagine no one better. If you happen to be available, you can find them in the Grove—just keep your ears open.

—Dagonet

Greetings,We received a message from one of our contacts. It included a note personally addressed to you, and we agreed that his words eloquently express our own opinion. I'm passing it on to you. You can read it below."As an adventurer, you are able to come and go at your will. In your travels across the Fields of Ruin, you chose to stop and help those in need, even though they are different from you and their struggles are alien to yours. Your acts exemplify the heart of the treaty we're working toward—that we can accomplish more together than we can just serving our own ends. Thank you." —Wade Samuelsson, Commander of EbonhawkeExploration is more than simply travel. It's about discovery and how you work with what you find. It seems you're doing a fantastic job. We are proud to have you among our members.—Tyrian Explorers Society

Commander,

We're preparing for the next battle. Return to the Eye of the North. Your army needs its commander.

—Ogden Stonehealer

Commander,I heard about the loss of your demolitionist pal Tonn. I didn't know him, but I think I might have gotten along with him—people who like to blow stuff up tend to keep the conversation lively. Try not to let his death ruin the rest of your war, and keep up the good work.I think Eir is plotting something to smooth things over between me and her, or me and the rest of Destiny's edge. I may see what she's got in mind, just for a laugh. I'll let you know how it goes.Until then,—Zojja

Commander,

While the Vigil continues to struggle against the constant encroachment of enemy forces, I did manage to send a small scouting party to explore the unopened gate we discovered leading into the western mountains.

After much trial and error, the scouts were finally able to dissipate the Svanir shaman's corruptive magic and unlock the door with a Raven lens. Rytlock and Crecia went through almost immediately to chase down Bangar, though I've yet to hear word from either one since they passed through.

I don't have any scouts I'm comfortable sending through the gate, but I know what lies on the other side: the lake where Svanir called out to the Ice Dragon's champion long ago. It is a place of great power. Great and terrifying power.

Be careful.

—Jhavi

Congratulations on completing the episode!

You have now unlocked additional story instance achievements and the ability to replay this episode from the Journal tab located in your Hero panel. You can now revisit this story whenever you choose. While replaying an episode, you will notice that there are now purple star markers indicating the location of instances that contain achievements. You can visit these instances out of order and replay them as many times as you like.
Commander, I know the queen takes you at your word. Just know...I had nothing to do with whatever this is.
Welcome to the Golem Recombobulator. What would you like to do?

Greetings, Commander!

Rumor has it you've uncovered a way to harvest unbound magic, which is an invaluable resource that I would love to get my hands on. Who knows, it may even help us get underway! If you have any to spare, come see me on the airship bridge, and I'll make it worth your while.

I've been working on some aerial combat tactics that all the loose magic in the area might actually make feasible, but I'll need unbound magic to complete my prototype.

—Natto
Welcome, young one.

Commander,

First: sincerest congratulations on bringing down Kralkatorrik. Three Elder Dragons and a god—very impressive. That merits contemplation.

Which brings me to my second point: Tyria is changing. I find myself wondering about the shape of this new world and what the future holds for the Charr. So I've invited my fellow imperators, along with their best and brightest, to our Homelands for a grand convocation. A celebration of who the Charr are—and who we might become. I've even brokered a ceasefire with remnants of Flame, believe it or not.

I've also extended an invitation to some of our allies, and it should come as no surprise that you and your guild are at the top of that list. It would be my privilege to host a "champion" of your renown. (And one of us, no less.)

After all, who else can say they have an Elder Dragon at their command?

I look forward to meeting you in the flesh. You'll find a chopper waiting at the Black Citadel.

Yours sincerely,

Bangar Ruinbringer
Imperator
Blood Legion
Welcome to the future site of Camp Renewal–the Consortium's housing project for those displaced by Molten Alliance brutality.

Greetings,

Your deeds in the Forsaken Thicket are well known. It has come to my attention that you have assembled a very remarkable set of armor, and I would like to offer my expertise to help improve it to make a truly legendary creation.

If you are interested, come talk to me in Lion's Arch.

Greetings, Traveler! Hail, Seeker of Legends!

It has been brought to my attention that you have attained the rank of Revered Antiquarian and are now ready to begin the long and difficult journey to crafting a legendary weapon! Congratulations!

When you are ready to begin on this momentous mission, come see me. I can be found by the crafting stations near Trader's Forum in Lion's Arch. I look forward to seeing you.

Yours legendarily,
Grandmaster Craftsman Hobbs
"Welcome to Mistlock Observatory inside the Fractals of the Mists! Please don't mind the mess, we're doing science."

"Welcome to the Durmand Priory, novice. Your new order's plan to distribute Professor Gorr's theory involves a gathering of all the finest minds in Rata Sum...and your job is to see that they survive to pass along what they learn."

Commander,The Luxons called the Jade Sea home once. Though that was a long time ago...We heard of your efforts in protecting this land. Our home. We also heard you've found yourself a siege turtle egg. We'd like to help you raise it, should you choose to keep it.Meet with my sister, Rota. I believe she's working out of Arborstone. She will guide you.—Valrun
"Greetings, Initiate. The Preceptors are expecting you."
"Greetings, hero! Today, the world is one day older—which makes it quite old. If you're here to celebrate our time in Tyria, I have just the thing...if you can bring me proof of your deeds."

Greetings, traveler, 

Good work exploring Bloodtide Coast. As I hear it, you nearly became fish bait, and you were faced with vicious undead, but you persevered. Your success is an indicator of your hardiness and initiative.

You'll be spoken of in legend one day. 

—Tyrian Explorers Society
"Welcome to Temperus Point, Blood Legion HQ out in the wilds of Ashford. We're pushing out to reclaim our land."

Dear %str1%, 

It was a sad day today in Winslow Manor. We had to bid farewell to our dear, devoted Mr. Nibbles. When he left us, he took a piece of me with him—specifically, one of my toes. But the domain soldiers on nonetheless. I'm even thinking of planting a garden!

All my best to you and yours,
Lord Blaine, Archduke of the Well of Winslow

Wayfinder, my friend!Because of your aid, we are getting potions to the front lines at the Bastion of Strength. While I was cleaning up, I noticed an incredibly curious card in my cauldron. Surely it wasn't there before you departed, but I felt an incredible urge to send it to you right away. It doesn't look like much to me, but perhaps maybe you can make some use of it?Stay vibrant, darling.Z
Congratulations to the Crystal Harmonics krewe for its isolation of rarified ley-line containment. You are Rata Novus' krewe of the day.

"Welcome to Diessa Plateau. Traveling east of the haven, you'll find a few of our soldiers are on holiday celebrating Meatoberfest. It's a grand festival where you can eat and drink as much as you want. The only downside to the festival is that it makes us regular targets for Separatists. The noise also causes us grief with the dredge. They have a large base of operations north of the festival. And if they're not bothering us here, they're off bothering the miners at the quarry. We'd appreciate any assistance you could offer us. And don't forget to have a good time!"
Welcome to the Eye of the North. Ages ago, when the Great Destroyer stirred, the Ebon Vanguard held this bastion of hope and joined forces with a special hero to prevent the destruction of us all.

Greetings, friend,Bash dragons and celebrate your victories by drinking this unique barley wine! Its mild body and rich fruity flavors will always leave you wanting another sip, which can be dangerous, much like fighting dragons. Dragon Bash Barley Wine greatly adds to the experience of this time of year. Good health and a glass for your thirst,—Desch Metz,Master Brewer, Eldvin Monastery

Commander,

I watched your interaction with the Inquest at a distance. I'll be sending another scout to take the surviving asura into alliance custody and get them patched up. When you're ready, meet me back at the hunter's camp; we should discuss next steps.

—Choole

Commander,
What happened to demolitionist Tonn was a tragedy, but you cannot let it ruin your resolve. I know something about losing those with whom you go into battle, and I won't let you make the same mistakes I made.
Don't focus on what went wrong. Focus on the fact that you sank Zhaitan's flagship. That will make the Pact's ultimate victory much, much easier to achieve.
I am still working to heal the rifts that keep Destiny's Edge at each other's throats, but it is slow going. Zojja is especially difficult to reach, so I'm currently focusing my efforts on her. Wish me luck.
May the Spirits continue to guide you to victory,
—Eir

Commander,

Very exciting news! A crystalline resonance cascade scenario has occurred! You can read my upcoming publication...wait. That book already exists; it's right here on my desk.

This already happened!

Okay, so, remember when all of your green prophet shards and crystals turned blue? Maybe you don't; I somehow forgot. That was the primary crystalline resonance cascade scenario—it happened a while ago! BUT! NOW! This is so amazing: it REBOUNDS! I thought the original scenario passed and was done. All my theories are wrong! This book is blissfully foul and wrong! I don't deserve this truly massive shelf full of awards and accolades! I have to go throw it all out and consult my crystals! Red prophet shards don't even exist! Why would I write about them?

I'm back. This is fine. Everything is fine. I don't care what Phlunt says—crystallography has not been turned on its sixth axis at all. We're OK. This is just going to keep happening periodically and that's fine.

Your green prophet shards have turned blue. Again. My associate Zazzl now collects blue shards because all the shards in Cantha are blue now. This is just the world we live in.

I'm assigning another protege—very smart kid—Nikki, to go find where the locus of green shards is centering. She'll take them off your hands until the next rebound event.

Commander %str1%,

We have heard your request to speak with the Pale Tree. She has moments of clarity, but they're unpredictable and interspersed with long periods of unconsciousness. Please, come at your convenience, but you'll have to wait until she awakens.

—Mender Aine of the Grove

Greetings, friend,

This month is full of joy, pranks, and creativity. Our friends brewing in the Black Citadel have created an unusual but delicious drink. Rytlager Brimstout is a potent and unforgiving brew, much like its heroic namesake. It's also safe to assume that the brewers were well into their supply before deciding on the name.

Good health and a glass for your thirst,

—Desch Metz,
Master Brewer, Eldvin Monastery
Welcome, outsider.

Wayfinder, keep working on your battle magic. You will need it in the wars to come. Strength comes from the mind, after all.

Speaking of, take this as a memento of your time here. I found it among the rubble during my rounds. You came to mind, in the most...uncanny way.

Vanak
Welcome to the Sound Effect Test Map
"Welcome, recruits. You now join the proud ranks of the Vigil."

Welcome to the Vigil, recruit. Rakt and the Arcane Eye have chosen to be an obstacle to the free distribution of Professor Gorr's theory, so the Vigil's doing what it does best: crushing all obstacles in its path.
"Greetings, featherless one."
Welcome back. How can I assist you?
Welcome to our drab little encampment. It may be under-staffed, under-supplied, and elemental-infested, but we make do.
Welcome to Xunlai Jade Air Purifier Model 4-J, your one-stop shop for refreshing your jade bot's air filtration systems!

Greetings, friend,

Now is a time of joy and terror for all of Tyria. Brewed from ingredients that include Kryta's finest pumpkins, Mad King's Pumpkin Porter delivers a preferable alternative to the trickster spirits tormenting Lion's Arch. This brew hits all the right notes for a pumpkin beer. Medium-bodied and easy to drink, enjoy the lightly spiced flavors that dance across your tongue. 

Good health and a glass for your thirst,

—Desch Metz,
Master Brewer, Eldvin Monastery

Dear fan,As a supporter or participant in the events at Vehtendi Arena—Elona's most spectacular sports venue—please accept this message as recognition of your contribution to the games. Praise Joko!—MC Turgut
"Welcome, welcome."
Commander,I wish to discuss an important matter with you. Meet me at your home as soon as possible.—Ridhais
Welcome to Ascalon City. We're still fighting a battle hundreds of years old, to reclaim our rightful lands. Something has to be done to drive the ghosts out, for good.

Greetings, Wayfinder. I trust your time at sea hasn't treated you too poorly.    The Astral Ward's expedition to Castora has resulted in a large influx of recordkeeping for the Wizard's Vault and new issues to investigate. A developing situation is beyond the means of our scouts, so I would like to recruit your capable hands to the task.    Ward and Tyrian Alliance scholars believe the Castoran coral reefs are a vital part of the local arcane ecosystem, potentially cultivated by the island's original residents. However, the latest reporting suggests local Inquest experiments may be targeting this critical system.    This field operation has been filed under the name "Castoran Coral." Commander,  
  
The following steps must be completed in order and with the utmost care and precision. There is some amount of danger if we do not proceed with caution and handle each item appropriately. We wouldn't want to scald that pretty face of yours. And by scald, I imply uncertain death.    
  
**Step One**: First, you must take the sample of pyrite and break it down to a fine powder using the metalworking station's hammering function.  
  
**Step Two**: Once you have the pyrite powder, bring it to me, and I'll prepare it for the next phase.  
  
**Step Three**: While I'm working on that, you can extract the magical components, ideally using the following sequence, as that will create the most potent reaction:  
- Use the preparation station to extract the ley energy.  
- Next, use the preparation station to extract the seer magic.  
- Finally, use the metalworking station to crack open the Inquest magitech container using the hammering function. Then use the preparation station to extract the energy.  
  
**Step Four**: Once those are done, return to me. I should have what you need for the next steps.  
   
**Step Five**: Take the solution that I give you and *CAREFULLY* use it with the following components at the preparation and metalworking stations. As before, completing these steps in the following sequence will produce the strongest chemical reaction:  
- Before you can do any leaching, you must add the caustic solution to the preparation station.  
- Hammer the saltpeter until it's crushed. If you've added the caustic solution to the station already, you should be able to leach the crushed saltpeter.  
- Do the same and hammer the alum crystal into small chips. Then, you can leach them.  
- Repeat the above steps with the oxidized copper hunk, but instead of hammering it first, you need to ablate it at the preparation station. After that, you can leach the refined oxidized copper hunk.  
  
**Step Six**: While you are creating those components, I will take the crude oil and work it to create what we need. You needn't do anything with it, love.    
  
**Step Seven**: Take the power cell to the preparation station and extract its power core.  
  
**Step Eight**: Take the sheet metal to the metalworking station and choose the molding function—don't worry, I've already installed the casting shape we'll need. Then, take the molded casing to the finishing station and use the coat function on it to reinforce the material.  
  
**Step Nine**: Take the hourglass to the finishing station; you'll want to apply a plating to the item.  
  
**Step Ten**: Finally, take the leather straps to the finishing station and apply a good polish to make sure that it's supple and strong enough to use for carrying the device.
